notes: Buzzword-heavy founder pitch. Tests ambiguity flags with measurable follow-up questions and no invented features.
input: We want a modern, AI-powered CRM that's super easy to use and really fast. It should help sales teams close more deals and integrate with everything. Ideally it scales to enterprise. Think Salesforce but better and way simpler.

questionsAbout: team size and what enterprise scale means
who the users are and what easy to use means
core CRM records such as contacts, deals and pipeline
